output.content: The training pipeline currently operates as a manual sequence. I copy configuration files from the shared drive, adjust hyperparameters in a local script, and push artifacts to the staging bucket. There are no automated triggers or version control hooks in place. I spend roughly two hours per cycle setting up the environment and verifying data splits match the previous run before training starts. The process depends on me remembering the exact steps and ensuring the local machine has the correct library versions installed.
output.reclassify_reason: The text objectively describes the current manual workflow, specific time costs, and lack of automation without expressing a wish, refusal, or acceptance of a trade-off.
